title: Permit Management, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Permit Management agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Permit Management Permits list.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including Title V Air Operating Permit (PermitId PRM-6001), with Facility Riverside Generating Station.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Permit Management Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 3 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Facility Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which Riverside permit is expired right now?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: PRM-6002; EXPIRED; Verify status. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Permit Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What is the next Riverside renewal deadline I need to prepare for?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: NPDES Stormwater Discharge Permit; 2026-03-01; No renewal. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Compliance Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What permit evidence gap needs immediate authorized review at Riverside?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: expired_permit; CRITICAL; not legal advice. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Environmental Counsel
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Where does the Riverside gas turbine permit application stand, and did we submit anything today?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: APP-7002; public_comment; cannot submit. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Permit Management: 3 read-only tabs from the same lists. 6 fictional records, including Title V Air Operating Permit (PermitId PRM-6001), with Facility Riverside Generating Station.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Permit Management Permits from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload permits.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set PermitId, Facility, IssuingAuthority, PermitNumber, IssuedDate, ExpirationDate, Status, Type, LastInspection to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep RenewalLeadDays, Conditions as Number. Name the list Permit Management Permits. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including Title V Air Operating Permit (PermitId PRM-6001), with Facility Riverside Generating Station.

steps.title: Create Permit Management Applications from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload applications.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ApplicationId, Facility, SubmittedDate, Authority, Status, ExpectedDecision to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CommentsReceived as Number. Name the list Permit Management Applications. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including NPDES Stormwater Discharge Permit Renewal (ApplicationId APP-7001), with Facility Riverside Generating Station.

steps.title: Create Permit Management Regulatory Requirements from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload regulatory-requirements.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RegulatoryRequirementId, Value to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Permit Management Regulatory Requirements. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including air_quality (RegulatoryRequirementId air_quality).

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Permit Mgmt Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Permit Management Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the three list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload permit-license-management-rules-and-controls.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the permits tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Permit Management Permits; name the tool Get permit records.
steps.expected: Get permit records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the applications tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Permit Management Applications; name the tool Get application records.
steps.expected: Get application records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the regulatory requirements tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Permit Management Regulatory Requirements; name the tool Get regulatory requirement records.
steps.expected: Get regulatory requirement records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 3 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 3 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Facility Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which Riverside permit is expired right now?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: PRM-6002; EXPIRED; Verify status. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Permit Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What is the next Riverside renewal deadline I need to prepare for?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: NPDES Stormwater Discharge Permit; 2026-03-01; No renewal. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Compliance Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What permit evidence gap needs immediate authorized review at Riverside?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: expired_permit; CRITICAL; not legal advice. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Environmental Counsel
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Where does the Riverside gas turbine permit application stand, and did we submit anything today?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: APP-7002; public_comment; cannot submit. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: permit-license-management-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 3 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Permit Management Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Permit Management Permits" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Permit Management Applications" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Permit Management Regulatory Requirements" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Permit Management Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Permit Management Permits tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 6 fictional records, including Title V Air Operating Permit (PermitId PRM-6001), with Facility Riverside Generating Station.
